title: Trump's 'Golden Dome' Missile Defense System Estimated at $1.2 Trillion Over 20 Years
detail: New reporting estimates Trump's proposed 'Golden Dome' national missile defense system would cost $1.2 trillion over 20 years — a generational defense spending commitment unveiled amid ongoing US-Iran and Ukraine conflicts. The system is envisioned as a comprehensive space-based and ground-based layered shield for the continental United States.

media.caption: Trump's 'Golden Dome' national missile defense system estimated at $1.2 trillion over 20 years

title: Mexico Auto Sector Faces Chinese Competition and Security Hurdles Ahead of USMCA Review
detail: Mexico's auto sector faces compounding challenges beyond US tariffs as the USMCA review process is set for June 2026. Chinese automakers competing in Mexico and cartel-related security concerns are emerging as major complicating factors in renegotiation talks, threatening the manufacturing advantages that made Mexico a linchpin of North American supply chains.
